item.text: {"text":"The goal is to qualify controller version 2.6 at 0.80 m/s, with a 2.50 ms PWM period, a maximum load of 4.00 kg, and an ambient temperature of 18.0 to 28.0 degrees C. For motor M17 only, reduce the maximum load to 2.75 kg when the ambient temperature is more than 26.0 degrees C. At exactly 26.0 degrees C, the 4.00 kg limit applies. The timing limit is a 99th percentile of 3.00 ms. H2 withdraws the version 2.5 pass claim. The corrected version 2.5 result is 3.20 ms and fails the limit. Version 2.6 timing is not tested. H3 reports a watchdog fault in 3 of 5 simulator runs at a load of 3.60 kg. The cause is unknown and must not be reported as established. Do not use zero for an unknown quantity to make a check pass. Release is on hold until version 2.6 timing passes and the watchdog fault is resolved. A proposed extra test is optional. The operating settings and motor exception did not change."}
